newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Strattec Security estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Strattec Security estimate raised.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial said that on Monday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Strattec Security Corp to $1.74 a share from $1.68 in the wake of the company's performance in the second quarter.

-- Mesirow analyst Greg Salchow said revenues in the period were $37.9 million, compared with his estimate of $37.2 million. He said the company continues to make progress toward better production process control.
-- Salchow expects the company to continue to widen its product margins as improvements are made throughout the year.
-- Strattec Security makes mechanical locks for the automotive industry.
-- The shares were up 1/4 at 18-3/4 Monday afternoon.
